definition: Two mutually exclusive and exhaustive hypotheses W and V, rational prior p with 0<p<1, and positive likelihoods at most one for the same received event. The normalizer is p*lW+(1-p)*lV; posteriorW and posteriorV divide these weighted likelihoods by the normalizer. Positive likelihood ratio is evidence support; posterior preference also depends on prior. Community is an ignored argument of publicAssessment; swap complements prior and exchanges likelihoods.
